p: 3-Second Visual Hook with Bold Text Overlay + UI Demo

Open with motion/product in action or provocative on-screen text (3-6 bold words, high contrast), large captions for muted viewing (70-85% of plays), showing cursor/input-to-output workflow in first 3s. Total length 15-30s for ads.

if we apply this, CTR improves because it stops the scroll immediately (X data shows majority impressions <3s) and retains silent viewers via text, driving higher completion and clicks vs static or slow intros

p: Search X for the last 14 days: products that turn coding-agent output (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) into shareable pages or team-reviewable docs (e.g. Showly, Velven, Claude Artifacts publishing, Codex

**Showly** (showly.ai) is the only product with meaningful recent promotion on X matching the criteria.[[1]](https://x.com/NenukoRG4L/status/2101705125194567692)

- **Promoter**: @NenukoRG4L (Moritz Klein; bio indicates AI/tech focus, no follower count available). Organic-looking thread-style post with video demo.  
  Exact one-line message: “Don't leave great agent work buried in a chat. 💬 Start free → https://showly.ai”  
  Engagement: 64 likes, 68 reposts, 10 replies, 13.4k views.  
  What the message leaves out: team ownership / access controls, agent-neutral compatibility, comment feedback loops to the agent, or versioned same-URL permanence.[[1]](https://x.com/NenukoRG4L/status/2101705125194567692)

- **Promoter**: @testingcatalog (AI news account). Organic news-style post with video.  
  Exact one-line message (core claim): “Showly now allows users to connect coding agents and give the agent-built work a shareable link.”  
  Engagement: 72 likes, 2 reposts, 30 replies, 14.2k views.  
  What the message leaves out: team ownership, agent-neutral aspects, comments feeding back to the agent, or same-URL version stability.[[2]](https://x.com/testingcatalog/status/2099812620895175119)

- Additional similar low-engagement reposts exist from accounts like @loganjassalley and others, all echoing the same “agent output → shareable page” framing without the omitted features.

**OpenArtifacts** (open-source Claude Artifacts alternative) has one relevant post.

- **Promoter**: @logancyang (self-described “File over app for AI”). Organic announcement.  
  Exact one-line message: “OpenArtifacts is an open source alternative to Claude Artifacts that works with any agent.”  
  Engagement: 24 likes, 6 reposts, 5 replies, 1.2k views.  
  What the message leaves out: team ownership, comments feeding back to the agent, or guaranteed same-URL versioning across agent runs.[[3]](https://x.com/logancyang/status/2099906214553604134)

**All other queried items** (Velven, Claude Artifacts publishing tools beyond the above, Codex share, Vercel previews, v0/Lovable/Bolt sharing) returned **INSUFFICIENT_DATA** in the last 14 days. No promotional posts matching the criteria.
